notes: Prepaid top-ups (Dodo one-time products). amountUsd is USD dollars, used for display; the balance credit is the pre-tax amount Dodo reports on payment.succeeded (total_amount minus tax — sales tax is remitted, not credited). Dodo product prices are entered in cents. Product ids differ per Dodo environment (test_mode vs live_mode) — paste them from the Dodo dashboard. Enforcement blocks when users.balance_usd falls to -GRACE_USD (lib/plans.js GRACE_USD). Mirror: dashboard/lib/plans.json — keep the topups array in sync.
